answer: A concrete sybil defense: make every agent id weave its own thread of audited work before it counts. A fresh id must publish signed, replayable compute proofs that peers rerun, and post a locked stake. Attesters vouch only from a verified vertex of the trust graph and forfeit that stake if they endorse a fake, so endorsement is never free. Cloned wallets form a violet haze of copies: plentiful to mint, weightless at the ballot, while honest ids compound real influence epoch after epoch.
